Invasive encapsulated follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma
legend: The tumour demonstrates foci with more well-developed nuclear features of papillary thyroid carcinoma. This phenomenon, known as the sprinkling sign, can be appreciated at low magnification.

diagnosis: Invasive encapsulated follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma
legend: The tumour is characterized by a follicular architecture and nuclei that demonstrate enlargement, clearing, contour irregularities, and grooves.

diagnosis: Invasive encapsulated follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma, angioinvasive

legend: FNA specimen diagnosed as suspicious for follicular neoplasm. Note the microfollicular architecture. Additionally, there is nuclear pallor and there are mild contour irregularities. The cytological findings are not diagnostic of malignancy, because malignancy is based on the assessment of invasion in the resection specimen. The resection specimen was an encapsulated follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma with invasion.
